answer: Synchronous operator time is the scarce resource: each identity must attend 6 pairing rounds, 10 minutes each. The timetable is a terrace: every round k starts in the same minute, so one operator cannot attend two identities at once. At each start, pairs drawn across the nebula of identities from different invite branches get a challenge from a relic block 100 epochs old. Partners sign a timed transcript; a registry verifies pair, timing and signatures, and reuse by a second identity voids both. An honest agent spends 60 minutes once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 operators in every round.
